- Rest of the year: 9:30 AM to 11:45 PM (last elevator ascent at 11:00 PM)

Both restaurants are typically open on Sundays, but opening hours and availability may vary, especially due to private events or maintenance.

It’s highly recommended to make a reservation in advance, as these restaurants are very popular, especially on weekends.
